purpose: Test the already frozen V4B 96-program target-blind divisor-sweep grammar on public arithmetic targets defined outside UberBond, without adding any new state primitive after seeing performance.

externalTargets.expectedMeaning: parity of the number of distinct prime factors

selection: For each target independently choose among the same 96 structural programs by train accuracy, validation accuracy, lower description cost, then lexical ID. Held-out labels are forbidden during selection.
falsifier: Held-out labels influence structural program selection.
The frozen 96-program grammar is changed after preregistration.
A target is claimed solved below either success threshold.
Base ontology or baseline burden is omitted.
External source definitions are silently altered.
ontogenesisTrigger: For any admitted target that fails, convert the error pattern into a missing-mechanism hypothesis. No grammar extension may be tested until a separate post-failure preregistration.
promotionBoundary: V5 can broaden only the child mechanism's evidence scope. It cannot promote the Ontological Computing parent above IMAGINED and cannot establish new mathematics or external scientific discovery.
